purpose: Coverage only, before effect modelling; no choice of final solar basis or outcome metric
method: NOAA approximate general solar position equations, geometric solar-centre elevation without refraction, at midpoint of actual first/last observed record in each minute and mean observed DR coordinates
time_basis: First scenario follows repositoryUTC declaration forDateTime mapped toTimestamp. Second adds3h to the naive timestamp as a diagnostic alternate clock interpretation; it does not establish that local-time interpretation is correct.
zero_degree_reference: Above/below geometric horizon is used solely to verify sunlight coverage; this is not a frozen model's daylight definition and differs from apparent sunrise/sunset incorporating refraction and disk radius.
count_precision: Counts classify observed minutes by their actual-observation midpoint. Weighted-second counts are seconds in those minutes, not second-exact horizon crossing classifications. Min/max are observed-minute-midpoint extrema.
